- [Cloud](https://docs.autopi.io/core/returners/core-returners-cloud.md): Return a result to [Cloud](https://www.autopi.io/software-platform/cloud-management) cache.

- [Event](https://docs.autopi.io/core/returners/core-returners-event.md): Publishes a job execution notification on the minion`s local event bus.
- [Event Result](https://docs.autopi.io/core/returners/core-returners-event-result.md): Publishes an entire job result on the minion`s local event bus.
- [Introduction](https://docs.autopi.io/core/core-returners-intro.md): Returners are executed on the device and are responsible for transferring command results, events and other data to a given system or endpoint. In an upcoming release it will be possible for users to code their own custom returners in Python.
- [Jsonl](https://docs.autopi.io/core/returners/core-returners-jsonl.md): Return a result to JSONL file.
- [Mqtt](https://docs.autopi.io/core/returners/core-returners-mqtt.md): Return a result to MQTT.
- [Acc Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-acc-manager.md): Adds device orientation (in degrees) which attempts to report back the exact orientation of the device to the ground.
- [Api Service](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-api-service.md): Serves the local REST API for running AutoPi commands.
- [Audio Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-audio-manager.md): Play a given audio file using the `aplay` command.
- [Ble Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-ble-manager.md): Flashes new firmware to the BlueNRG device.
- [Can Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-can-manager.md): Converts raw CAN data using the CAN database available for the current protocol. The CAN database file (.dbc) is found on the local file system by the following path expression:
- [Cloud Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-cloud-manager.md): Queries/calls a given cache function.
- [Crypto Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-crypto-manager.md): Queries a given command.
- [Docker Monitor](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-docker-monitor.md): Internal service for monitoring container changes.
- [Doip Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-doip-manager.md): Gets current context.
- [Ec2X Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-ec2x-manager.md): Manages current connection.
- [Event Reactor](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-event-reactor.md): Ensures a worker thread is scheduled for events with a detain period specified. Only one scheduled worker thread can exist at a time.
- [Gnss Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-gnss-manager.md): Converts a GNSS location result into position type.
- [Introduction](https://docs.autopi.io/core/core-services-intro.md): A variety of services are running on the device, each having its own specific area of responsibility. Most services are built around the same structure and using the same concepts which are described below.
- [Key Fob Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-key-fob-manager.md): Performs a key fob button action.
- [Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-manager.md)
- [Modem Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-modem-manager.md): Queries a given connection class command.
- [Obd Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-obd-manager.md): Converts a voltage reading result with battery charge state and level.
- [Process Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-process-manager.md): Starts a new process if it`s not already started.
- [Rfid Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-rfid-manager.md): If there are any authorized_tokens saved in context, this handler will attempt to authenticate an RFID against those tokens. Triggers `system/rfid/<rfid>/rejected` and `system/rfid/<rfid>/authenticated` events.
- [Spm Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-spm-manager.md): Flashes new SPM firmware to the MCU.
- [Tracking Manager](https://docs.autopi.io/core/services/core-services-tracking-manager.md): Converts a GNSS location result into position type.
